prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1203; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents damage to the rear quarter panel and bumper cover consistent with a low-speed impact, but the deformation sits on the opposite side from the account given and at a higher point on the body than the described contact would produce. Parts and paint blends are identified on the estimate. Labor hours for the panel repair appear slightly generous for the scope visible, and I recommend a second review of those lines. Invoices submitted with the claim show no duplicated charges. No prior damage to this vehicle is recorded in our files. Recommended plan: replace the rear bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and verify the sensor calibration before release.
